scripts.dev:api: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint:api: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run ruff check apps/api tests
scripts.test:api:integration: env RUN_POSTGRES_INTEGRATION=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run pytest -m integration tests/integration
scripts.check: pnpm lint:web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:web && pnpm lint:api && pnpm test:api
